transport: trusted in-process composition; account must come from an authenticated principal
actionCount: non-empty; no separate business count limit, bounded by canonical bytes and execution budgets
unsupported: flow.* and rules in flow/calculation mode

notificationSource.sourceActionIndex: zero-based earlier action index; excludes sourceCommandId/sourceOp; resolved to the deterministic child command ID and operation by the host

preflight.notes: No writes or random draws; checks sequential staged state until the first random-dependent item. Remaining dependent items are runtime_required. All operation/scope/schema admission checks run before staging. If admission fails, otherwise eligible items are runtime_required and have not run business checks. Deterministic items may include permission-projected result and preview:true; IDs/results are provisional. A passed result is a point-in-time check, not a future execution guarantee.

receipt.notes: result is the execution DTO. Pending/unknown has no completed execution. Same account and command ID with the same actions returns the existing receipt; different content raises COMMAND_ID_CONFLICT. Child IDs are batch- + SHA256(canonical([command_id,index])). Results reapply current receipt permissions.

singleMemoryFact.scope: single authoritative host memory fact and receipt; not part of execute_batch
singleMemoryFact.principal: KP only; trusted AI service validates source refs and memory-specific ownership first
singleMemoryFact.fact: complete next MemoryEntry, status confirmed or revoked, current host scopeId, revision greater than the current authoritative revision
singleMemoryFact.expected_revision: current host memoryFacts revision or 0 if absent; not the independent AI draft revision

receiptResult.memory: exact committed fact; AI mirror restores from this

singleMemoryFact.boundary: No AI-store write in this method. Multi-item host/AI combinations remain unsupported.

recovery: A durable intent and per-draw journal can survive a crash. Recovery requires the same room digest excluding this parent record. Changed room fails closed; no old snapshot restoration. The final business state, child receipts, notification outbox and parent success receipt publish together.
